question: Meng2020 only says 'WT'. Yu et al. 2016 (Sci Rep, PMC5137073) says the RNAi lines were made in Hi-II and introgressed into B73 as recurrent parent, with wild-type segregants as controls; R101 is ChromDB stock 3201-35. proposed_answer: Keep B73 background; consider genotype_class 'other inbred' for WT if residual Hi-II introgression matters.
